newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN 3RD TEST TO LEVEL SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN 3RD TEST TO LEVEL SERIES.

text.p: Australia quickly wrapped up the third test on Monday by capturing the remaining five England wickets in an hour and a half to win by 268 runs and square the six-match series 1-1.
England, 130 for five overnight, were all out for 200 with paceman Glenn McGrath taking four of the wickets to fall in the session.
Among his victims was England's top scorer John Crawley who unluckily trod on his wicket after making 83.
McGrath also dismissed Mark Ealham (nine), Robert Croft (seven) and Darren Gough (six) to finish with figures of four for 46.
Leg-spinner Shane Warne ended the match by having Andy Caddick caught for 17.
